key_idea: Look for a square that can only go with one neighbour, and see what is left.
steps: The L block has 3 squares with a bend. The bar has 2 squares in a row.
In shape D, the bottom square touches only the square above it. So those 2 squares must be in the same block.
If they are the bar, the top row of 3 is left. It is straight, not bent, so it is not the L block.
If they are in the L block, the third square must be the middle of the top row. Then the 3 squares are straight again. So D cannot be built.

choice_feedback.A: The 2 squares on the right side make the bar, and the other 3 make the L block.
choice_feedback.B: The top 2 squares make the bar, and the other 3 make the L block.
choice_feedback.C: The bottom 2 squares of the long column make the bar, and the other 3 make the L block.
choice_feedback.E: The top 2 squares make the bar, and the other 3 make the L block.
